why: Third-party published papers used as method sources for the RIM work. The repository etloveaui/100xFenok is PUBLIC, so a tracked copy is publicly downloadable regardless of the web tree. DEC-296 removed these from the deployed public tree and the site returns 404, but the source-repo copy stayed reachable over raw.githubusercontent.com — verified 200 with content-length 255461 on 2026-08-08.
action: Copies preserved on the SSD; the tracked copies are removed from the repository tip and the directory is ignored so the three untracked papers cannot land.
history_note: Removal from the tip does not remove the blobs from git history. Purging history requires a rewrite, which is forbidden here: the hourly autopull owns the tip and advances fast-forward only. That decision is the owner's.
